nutrition.description: Validated targeted briefing and decimal sprint regressions, typecheck, build, built CLI smoke tests, and the full Vitest suite.
Recorded S114.5 scorecard, review notes, and roadmap status.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: This was the right second layer: the registry now affects planning without making the agent launcher magical.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Keep recommendations explainable. If the reason cannot point to roadmap, filters, hazards, or history, do not rank it highly.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The useful UX catch was not ranking itself; it was suppressing false gap warnings from generic filter terms.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: Briefing can now nudge agents toward the right local skill before the first edit.

bunker_locations: Briefing skill gaps should require repeated common-issue or scorecard skill_gaps_found evidence; filter words alone are too noisy.
Decimal sprint CLI tests that execute dist need pnpm build before rerunning.
Skill recommendation reasons should stay human-readable and tied to concrete briefing context.
yardage_book_updates: slope briefing now loads config.skillsPath, defaulting to .slope/skills.json, and degrades quietly when no valid registry exists.
buildSkillBriefing ranks registered skills from current roadmap text, briefing filters, recent hazards, terminology overlap, and scorecard skill history.
The full briefing adds a Recommended Skills section before Hazards when recommendations or gaps exist.
Compact briefing includes a one-line Skills summary with the top three recommendation ids.
Skill gaps are sourced from repeated common issues and recent scorecard skill_gaps_found entries, not one-off filters.
course_management_notes: Added buildSkillBriefing and exported skill briefing types from src/core/briefing.ts.

pnpm test passed: 214 test files and 3467 tests.
skill_gaps_found: A future hardening pass should cover older ancillary CLI commands that still parse sprint ids as integers outside the S114.5 lifecycle path.
